verdict.rationale: Baseten documents function/tool calling, where the model chooses a tool and produces its arguments. It does this through OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, and its Switch support for routing Claude Code and Codex CLI implies tool-heavy agent loops can run on its Model APIs. The evidence is only a one-line description of basic tool calling, with no detail on parallel calls, multi-step loops, or how reliably arguments are produced. Missing for 10: documented parallel tool calls, documented multi-step tool-use loops, evidence of faithful argument/schema adherence across open models, independent or hands-on corroboration.
